verdict.rationale: Asana ships its own AI agents (AI Teammates, AI Studio), so asking whether it can connect external MCP servers as a client is a fair question. However, all the MCP evidence describes Asana's own MCP server, which exposes Asana to Claude, ChatGPT and other clients. That is the server role and does not count for this story. Nothing shows Asana's AI connecting to third-party MCP servers or using their tools, and the general claim about powering AI workflows with context from other apps never mentions MCP.
